text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Excuse meee!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? And here I thought I gave a polite 
greeting...
choice_data_list:
Then you should say "Excuse me" when you 
enter.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! I messed up! Whenever I try to be 
all formal, I get weirdly nervous.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer! Could you teach me perfect 
manners and etiquette?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Look, you know that outfit I got the other 
day? Someone reached out wanting to do an 
interview about it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's my super, super important formal 
attire, after all! So I want to master 
proper etiquette too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having done several magazine interviews 
before, I decided to accept, thinking it 
wouldn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The Complete Guide to Etiquette! I just 
need to memorize this? Leeeeave it to 
meee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Bow... and then greet... Wait, was it the 
other way around? Greet and then bow??

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Table manners are easy! If I remember 
right, you just work your way from the 
outside in...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What should I doooo!? Which one was 
I supposed to use on which againnn??
choice_data_list:
Let's use them in the order they were 
served.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Once I'm done eating, I lightly fold the 
napkin and place it on the right-hand 
side, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first, there was concern over how 
things would turn out, but through trial 
and error, she gradually acquired proper 
etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Your etiquette is practically one step 
away from perfection! At this rate, the 
interview is gonna go great!!
choice_data_list:
Is this interview somehow different from 
usual?

Is this interview somehow different from 
usual?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. The reporter doing this 
interview happens to be an acquaintance of 
my dad's.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
He's the person who once interviewed my 
dad for a sports trainer special a long 
time ago!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Someone like that is coming to interview 
me about my new outfit...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And for an interview about the outfit that 
holds everything my dad taught me, too!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Didn't I tell you?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"This outfit, you see, is filled with the 
respect for sports that my father taught 
me!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sports know no borders...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A sacred endeavor where everyone can 
compete fairly under common rules—that is 
what sports are!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's why when they made this outfit, I 
asked them to weave my dad's teachings 
into it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A crisp, dignified look inspired by strict 
sportsmanship!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's a design that easily grabs attention 
anywhere, so I can spread the joy of 
sports!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And you know! The reporter covering that 
outfit is an acquaintance of my dad's!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When I thought, "Miracles like this don't 
just happen!", I simply couldn't sit still 
anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I realized words alone weren't enough to 
convey Dad's teachings to a reporter who 
knew him!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A good sportsman is always polite! That's 
what Dad always said, so—
choice_data_list: So that's why you're learning etiquette...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Through my moves, I'll show that I've 
inherited everything my dad taught me!!
choice_data_list:
Then let's give it our all right until the 
very end!
I'm sure your feelings will get through.
I'm sure your feelings will reach them.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Through my moves, I'll show that I've 
inherited everything my dad taught me!!
choice_data_list:
Then let's give it our all right until the 
very end!
I'm sure your feelings will get through.
I'm sure your feelings will reach them.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! As soon as we get back, we're doing 
special training again from the very 
beginningーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for taking the trouble 
to travel all this way! I look forward to 
working with you today!!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Thank you for being so polite. Is 
this thanks to your father's upbringing, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! It's all thanks to my dad, and to 
you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you're both terribly proud. Now 
then, let's get started with the 
interview.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she wrapped up the interview 
properly, polite and full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're right! We worked hard for this, 
after all! I'm sure everything will go 
great during the real thing!!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
...So, what kind of feelings did you put 
into your new outfit?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What feelings went into this outfit... 
feelings... *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaah!! My dad's~ teachings, waaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
"...Ahaha! You're the spitting image of 
your dad! He was a big crybaby too~. Man, 
takes me back."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *hic*... Dad, too...?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. So I’m totally used to it! Take 
your time, there’s no rush.”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, once Winning Ticket calmed 
down, she was able to speak properly about 
her outfit.
